name: Drawer

componentSettings.label: Colors
componentSettings.description: Component-local color choices for drawer panels and navigation areas.

settings.label: Main Panel Color
settings.description: Controls the default drawer background, text contrast, field colors, and surface borders.

settings.label: Main Panel Color
settings.description: Controls the main drawer background when the drawer is duotone.

settings.label: Secondary Navigation Color
settings.description: Controls the secondary navigation area when the drawer is duotone.

settings.label: Overlay Color
settings.description: Controls the dimmed backdrop shown behind an open drawer, including its opacity.

componentSettings.label: Layout
componentSettings.description: Component-local sizing and spacing for the drawer panel and its navigation items.

settings.label: Spacing and Padding
settings.description: Controls drawer header, footer, and navigation item padding.

settings.label: Width Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplies the default drawer width without changing the global base unit.

componentSettings.label: Elevation
componentSettings.description: Component-local shadow controls for the open drawer state.

settings.label: Shadow Color
settings.description: Controls the color used by the drawer shadow.

settings.label: Shadow Intensity
settings.description: Controls how strong the drawer shadow appears when open.

description: The Drawer component provides a reusable pattern for drawer in the interface.
